extrusion: signed screw rotation matches the helix and conveys toward the die (+X)

extrusion: flying saw moves with the profile at line speed while cutting; one 500 mm cut per loop

blownfilm: upward nip contacts, one surface speed, BUR 2 bubble inside the cage, lay-flat = pi D / 2, steady bubble
blowmolding: continuous parison, capture, knife, 300 mm shuttle, 50 mm pin, 160 mm opening, bottle morph from the parison and conveyor take-out
blowmolding: clamp rods ride the mould halves from their cylinders and the shuttle rod from its cylinder through the full strokes
